o1: Predicted to enable phosphatidylinositol binding activity. Involved in cell polarity; anterior/posterior axis specification; establishment of mitotic spindle orientation; asymmetric cell division; and gonad development. Is located in the cell cortex, including P granule, anterior cell cortex, and apical cortex; is extrinsic component of cytoplasmic side of plasma membrane. Is part of the PAR polarity pathway. Is expressed in several structures, including AB; EMS; excretory cell; hermaphrodite gonad; and vulval cell. Orthologous to several human genes including PARD3B (par-3 family cell polarity regulator beta).
